WITH confidence_diff AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        `Confidence In National Government` - 
            (SELECT AVG(`Confidence In National Government`) FROM survey_data WHERE region = a.region)
        AS diff_score

        survey_data a

    c.region,
    ROUND(c.diff_score, 2) AS confidence_diff,
    e.economic_impact,
    e job_growth
FROM
    confidence_diff c

    economic_impacts e ON c.region = e.region_id
